summary: This is a Mol Labs public research discussion card (L30) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether β-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) retains longevity/healthspan/metabolic phenotype independent of HCAR2/GPR109A/PUMA-G signaling. The document frames a pre-registered rodent panel design with exogenous BHB vs. vehicle under Hcar2 genetic loss-of-function or HCAR2-matched blockade, with a ≥50% retention threshold for early healthspan/metabolic endpoints. No experiments have been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN); the document is a proposal/discussion grounded in four prior-art literature sources.

content_blocks.title: Document Overview and Status
content_blocks.content: Mol Labs public report card L30 (PUBLIC_REPORT_ONLY). Status: NEGATIVE (status_labels). Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Risk class: research-discussion. Polarity: negative. Novelty tag: assumption-kill. IP class: hcar2-insufficiency. Kill cost tier: 2. Time to refute: 6 weeks. Vault hold: no. The document is a research discussion/proposal, not a completed experiment.

content_blocks.title: Central Claim / Hypothesis
content_blocks.content: On a pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Roberts/Edwards-class) with exogenous BHB vs. vehicle under Hcar2 (HCAR2/GPR109A/PUMA-G) genetic LOF or HCAR2-matched blockade that abolishes HCAR2-class metabolic/healthspan attribution vs. HCAR2-intact concurrent controls: under the abolish lock, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (BHB vs. vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of the BHB vs. vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on HCAR2-intact concurrent controls on the same panel. Primary referee = pre-specified early healthspan/metabolic endpoint within the refute window (6 weeks). Full lifespan is only secondary, not a gate. This is an 'assumption-kill' of the hypothesis that BHB longevity/healthspan = mere HCAR2-necessary bridge.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: BHB longevity and metabolic-healthspan benefits are often framed as HCAR2/GPR109A-necessary because BHB is an endogenous HCAR2 ligand. Key prior art: (1) Taggart 2005 — BHB inhibits adipocyte lipolysis via PUMA-G (HCAR2/GPR109A); (2) Tunaru 2003 — PUMA-G/HM74 are receptors for nicotinic acid mediating antilipolytic effect; (3) Rahman 2014 — HCA2 REQUIRED for neuroprotective effect of BHB/KD in stroke (lost in Hca2-/-); (4) Roberts 2017 — KD extends murine longevity/healthspan with elevated circulating BHB but NO Hcar2 residual arm; (5) Edwards 2014 — D-BHB extends C. elegans lifespan ~20% via HDAC/DAF-16/SKN-1/SIR-2.1/AAK-2 but no mammalian HCAR2. A matched residual-positive BHB lifespan/healthspan H2H under mammalian Hcar2/HCAR2 abolish remains UNKNOWN/EMPTY.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: hcar2-insufficiency assumption-kill design: Roberts Cell Metab 2017 grounds adult-onset KD murine longevity/healthspan (circulating BHB elevated; protein acetylation/mTORC1 tissue-dependent) — phenotype founding; PMC HCAR2=0 GPR109A=0 PUMA-G=0 — NO Hcar2 residual arm; KD≠exogenous BHB alone. Edwards Aging 2014 grounds D-BHB C. elegans lifespan (~20% mean) via HDAC hda-2/hda-3, DAF-16/FOXO, SKN-1/Nrf, SIR-2.1, AAK-2/AMPK — phenotype founding; PMC HCAR2=0 (no mammalian HCAR2). Taggart JBC 2005 grounds D-BHB inhibits adipocyte lipolysis via PUMA-G (HCAR2/GPR109A) — lipolysis-class HCAR2 necessity ≠ residual-positive longevity. Tunaru Nat Med 2003 grounds PUMA-G/HM74 as nicotinic acid receptors mediating antilipolytic effect — HCAR2 genetic/tool foundation ≠ residual-positive longevity. Youm Nat Med 2015 — BHB blocks NLRP3 inflammasome independently of GPR109A/HCAR2 (Gpr109a-deficient BMDMs unaltered) — non-HCAR2 BHB path supporting possible residual for inflammasome phenotype; do not invent longevity residual. Preferred workflow: cell/tissue/block-QC (HCAR2-class antilipolytic/niacin-class or HCAR2-agonist response abolished) before new animal longevity runs.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary Table
content_blocks.content:
4 public prior art references cited:
1. PMID 28877457 / DOI 10.1016/j.cmet.2017.08.005 / PMC5609489 — Roberts 2017 (Cell Metab): Ketogenic diet extends longevity and healthspan in adult mice (circulating BHB elevated); PMC HCAR2=0 GPR109A=0 PUMA-G=0 — no Hcar2 residual arm; KD≠exogenous BHB alone. Role: founding ketone/BHB-class murine longevity/healthspan phenotype.
2. PMID 25127866 / DOI 10.18632/aging.100683 / PMC4169858 — Edwards 2014 (Aging): D-BHB extends C. elegans lifespan (~20% mean) via HDAC hda-2/hda-3, DAF-16, SKN-1, SIR-2.1, AAK-2; PMC HCAR2=0. Role: founding exogenous BHB longevity phenotype; non-HCAR2 bridges ≠ mammalian Hcar2 residual.
3. PMID 15929991 / DOI 10.1074/jbc.C500213200 — Taggart 2005 (JBC): D-BHB inhibits adipocyte lipolysis via nicotinic acid receptor PUMA-G (HCAR2/GPR109A). Role: lipolysis-class HCAR2 necessity / BHB→HCAR2 signaling; ≠ residual-positive longevity.
4. PMID 12563315 / DOI 10.1038/nm824 — Tunaru 2003 (Nat Med): PUMA-G and HM74 are receptors for nicotinic acid mediating anti-lipolytic effect. Role: HCAR2 genetic/tool foundation; ≠ residual-positive longevity.
Out of public prior art (≤4): PMID 24845831 — Rahman 2014 (Nat Commun): HCA2 REQUIRED for BHB/KD stroke neuroprotection (lost in Hca2-/-); ≠ organismal longevity residual.
Additional caveat: PMID 25686106 — Youm 2015 (Nat Med): BHB blocks NLRP3 independently of GPR109A/HCAR2.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Experimental Design
content_blocks.content: Method: propose-assay. Design: Pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel (Roberts/Edwards-class). Arms: exogenous BHB vs. vehicle × Hcar2/HCAR2 genetic LOF or HCAR2-matched blockade (abolish arm) vs. HCAR2-intact concurrent controls. Primary endpoint: early healthspan/metabolic improvement within 6-week refute window. Secondary endpoint: full lifespan (not a gate). Preferred workflow: (1) cell/tissue/block-QC confirming abolish of HCAR2-class control (antilipolytic/niacin-class or HCAR2-agonist response abolished) before new animal longevity runs; (2) in vivo healthspan panel as primary kill path within 6 weeks. Threshold: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement (BHB vs. vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of BHB vs. vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on HCAR2-intact concurrent controls. α/N pre-specified. No human dosing language. No invented residual effect sizes or KD/IC50.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered rodent metabolic/healthspan panel where Hcar2/HCAR2 LOF or HCAR2-matched blockade locks HCAR2-class control benefit abolished, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (BHB vs. vehicle under abolish) is <50% of the BHB vs. vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on HCAR2-intact concurrent controls — so BHB longevity/healthspan DOES reduce to mere HCAR2-necessary bridge — when abolish-fail, BHB-alone-null, underpowered-strata, assay-mismatch, or KD-vs-exogenous-BHB-confound artifacts are ruled out. Inconclusive (not refute) if: abolish-fail / BHB-alone-null on HCAR2-intact arm / underpowered strata / referee-assay mismatch / KD-vs-exogenous-BHB confound.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Known State
content_blocks.content: Soft-claims summary: Q_resid_life_h2h = EMPTY (residual-positive BHB lifespan/healthspan H2H under Hcar2 abolish UNKNOWN); Q_necess_healthspan longevity-class = EMPTY; lipolysis necessity = FOUND (Taggart); NP necessity = FOUND (Rahman, out of public prior art); PRIOR_ART PARTIAL (phenotype FOUND; HCAR2 lipolysis tools FOUND; residual longevity EMPTY; longevity necessity EMPTY). Soft-complete empty ≠ novelty / ≠ failure. L1–L29 ≠ proof of L30. Key distinctions: HCAR2 ≠ PHD2 (L29); HCAR2 ≠ TauT (L28); HCAR2 ≠ Klb/FGFR1 (L27); HCAR2 ≠ MT/melatonin (L26); HCAR2 ≠ SIRT1 (L25); HCAR2 ≠ SGLT2 (L24); HCAR2 ≠ GSK3 (L23); HCAR2 ≠ AMPK primary (L22); HCAR2 ≠ mitophagy (L21); HCAR2 ≠ bulk ATG (L20); BHB ≠ αKG; BHB ≠ metformin; KD ≠ exogenous BHB alone.

content_blocks.title: Competing Caveats / Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content: 1. Do not treat L1–L29 as proving L30 — new parent area bhb-hcar2-insufficiency. 2. Roberts 2017 is KD murine phenotype with no HCAR2 arm ≠ residual (KD≠exogenous BHB); Edwards 2014 is worm phenotype ≠ mammalian residual; Taggart/Tunaru are lipolysis necessity/receptor tools ≠ residual-positive longevity; Rahman NP HCAR2 necessity OUT of public prior art (≠ organismal longevity residual); matched residual-positive BHB lifespan/healthspan H2H UNKNOWN/EMPTY. 3. Competing outcomes that render test inconclusive (not refute): abolish-fail (block not actually abolishing HCAR2-class control benefit), BHB-alone-null on HCAR2-intact arm, underpowered strata, referee-assay mismatch vs Roberts/Edwards-class lock, KD-vs-exogenous-BHB confound. 4. NOT NAD-after-senolysis (SERIES_FROZEN). 5. Do not invent residual effect sizes or KD/IC50.

Residual-positive BHB lifespan/healthspan H2H under mammalian Hcar2/HCAR2 abolish is UNKNOWN/EMPTY — not invented.
Roberts 2017 (PMID 28877457): Adult-onset ketogenic diet extends murine longevity/healthspan with elevated circulating BHB; PMC HCAR2=0 — no Hcar2 residual arm; KD≠exogenous BHB alone.

Edwards 2014 (PMID 25127866): D-BHB extends C. elegans lifespan ~20% mean via HDAC hda-2/hda-3, DAF-16/FOXO, SKN-1/Nrf, SIR-2.1, AAK-2/AMPK; PMC HCAR2=0 — non-HCAR2 bridges ≠ mammalian Hcar2 residual.
Taggart 2005 (PMID 15929991): D-BHB inhibits adipocyte lipolysis via PUMA-G (HCAR2/GPR109A) — lipolysis-class HCAR2 necessity established; ≠ residual-positive longevity under Hcar2 abolish.
Tunaru 2003 (PMID 12563315): PUMA-G and HM74 are receptors for nicotinic acid mediating anti-lipolytic effect — HCAR2 genetic/tool foundation; ≠ residual-positive longevity.
Rahman 2014 (PMID 24845831, out of public prior art): HCA2 REQUIRED for neuroprotective effect of BHB/KD in stroke — effect LOST in Hca2-/- mice; ≠ organismal longevity residual.

Youm 2015 (PMID 25686106): BHB blocks NLRP3 inflammasome independently of GPR109A/HCAR2 in Gpr109a-deficient BMDMs — non-HCAR2 BHB path supporting possible residual for inflammasome phenotype; do not invent longevity residual.

Preferred workflow: cell/tissue/block-QC confirming HCAR2-class control abolish (antilipolytic/niacin-class or HCAR2-agonist response) before new animal longevity runs; primary kill path = in vivo healthspan panel within 6-week refute window.
